info.name: Britive Services API Documentation Shared Signals - Results API
Query processed shared signals event results

params.name: subjectValue
params.description: Filter by subject identifier value (e.g. email address).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results per page. Default 20, max 100.

params.name: direction
params.description: Filter by event direction. Omit to return all.

items.docs:
Results are returned in descending order by `receivedAt` (newest first).
Ordering is fixed to ensure stable pagination with `nextToken`.
